Centreon central deployed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

The install Job sets up the database (a few minutes on a fresh install):

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} logs -f job/{{ .Release.Name }}-install-{{ include "centreon-central.installId" . }}-{{ include "centreon-central.installJobSpec" . | sha256sum | trunc 6 }}

{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}

Then browse to {{ if .Values.ingress.tls }}https{{ else }}http{{ end }}://{{ .Values.ingress.host }}/centreon/
{{- else }}

No ingress: reach httpd with a port-forward, and set httpd.serverName to
the host:port you browse to (UseCanonicalName On), e.g.:

  helm upgrade ... --set httpd.serverName=localhost:28080
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/httpd 28080:80
{{- end }}

Apache ServerName in use: {{ include "centreon-central.serverName" . }}
Login: admin / secrets.adminPassword if it was set at the first install,
otherwise the image's install fixture password.

Remote pollers: pullwss through httpd{{ if .Values.ingress.enabled }} (the ingress){{ else }} (httpd.service, no ingress){{ end }}, path /centreon/gorgone/pullwss/websocket;
BBDO to the "centreon-broker" Service on 5669 (type {{ .Values.broker.service.type }}).
